questions.question: It was the lack of funding that made the project impossible to implement.
options: The lack of funding had been the reason for the project's failure.
It was because of a lack of funding that the project failed.
Lack of funding led to the impossibility of implementing the project.
Funding shortages were what made the project unworkable.
questions.answer: It was because of a lack of funding that the project failed.

questions.question: Unless I had studied harder, I wouldn't have passed the exam.
options: If I hadn't studied so hard, I would probably have failed.
I only managed to pass because I worked extremely hard.
Had I not put in such effort, I would likely have failed.
I'm surprised I passed given how little I studied.
questions.answer: Unless I had studied harder, I wouldn't have passed the exam.

questions.question: The only reason she agreed to meet him was because he promised not to mention her past.
options: She agreed to meet him on one condition: that he wouldn't bring up her past.
It was a promise not to discuss her past that made her agree to the meeting.
Her decision to see him was contingent upon his agreement to keep quiet about her past.
The only thing she wanted in exchange for meeting him was his silence about her past.
questions.answer: It was a promise not to discuss her past that made her agree to the meeting.

questions.question: Had I known about the traffic jam, I would have left earlier.
options: I should have left earlier if I had known there was going to be a traffic jam.
If only I'd known about the traffic, I could've left sooner.
Knowing about the traffic would have made me leave earlier.
I wish I'd been aware of the traffic so I could've set off earlier.
questions.answer: Had I known about the traffic jam, I would have left earlier.

questions.question: What she said was that unless we changed our strategy, we risked losing everything.
options: She warned us that if we didn't change our approach, we'd be in serious trouble.
It was her opinion that a change of plan was necessary to avoid disaster.
Unless we altered our tactics, she believed we would fail.
Her advice was to switch strategies before it's too late.
questions.answer: She warned us that if we didn't change our approach, we'd be in serious trouble.
